hook_line: Here's how to get real answers in just fifteen minutes with your doctor.

beats.narration: Before your visit, write down your top three concerns. Put the most worrying one first.
beats.label: Top Three First

beats.narration: Many people save their biggest worry for the end. Doctors call that the doorknob question. Don't wait.
beats.label: Doorknob Question

beats.narration: Bring your medication list, insurance card, past records, and your written questions.
beats.label: What To Bring

beats.narration: Use Ask Me Three: What's my main problem? What do I need to do? Why does it matter?
beats.label: Ask Me Three

beats.narration: Before leaving, repeat the plan back in your own words. This catches mistakes fast.
beats.label: Teach It Back

title: How To Get The Most From A 15-Minute Doctor Visit
